author: Daniel L. Davis
title: ⚠️ Macgregor: America Can No Longer Defend Its Forward Bases
text:
Col. Douglas Macgregor (@DougAMacgregor) lays out the hard truth: “We can’t defend them.” The destruction of U.S. bases shows the entire Middle East security architecture is collapsing.
He explains that the system was built on a decades‑old “grand bargain” with the Peninsular Arab states — they would recycle oil profits into U.S. treasuries and buy American weapons, and in return “we’ll defend you… you’ll be safe in perpetuity.”
Macgregor says that promise is now broken, and the evidence is on the ground.
He warns that Saudi Arabia “stands at least as good a chance… of going out of business” as other fragile post‑World War I constructs in the region.
His conclusion: America’s forward‑defense model is no longer viable — and the collapse has already begun.
